# Journeyhorizon

> Journeyhorizon is an expert in Sharetribe marketplace development and marketing, helping you to build, launch, and scale your business.

With expertise in Sharetribe and Marketing, we’ve worked with startups and enterprises worldwide, transforming ideas into market-leading platforms.

## Case Studies
- [Novabridge](https://www.journeyh.io/marketing-portfolio/novabridges-digital-transformation-powered-by-journeyhorizon):Novabridge, a leading Australian-owned consulting company and Elite Partner in the ServiceNow ecosystem, elevates their digital presence with help from Journeyhorizon.
- [GearSource](https://www.journeyh.io/portfolio/gearsource):GearSource, powered by the Sharetribe platform and developed by Journeyhorizon, is a global two-sided marketplace tailored for professionals in the audio, video, lighting, and staging industries.
- [Drivelah](https://www.journeyh.io/portfolio/drivelah):As one of the pioneering projects built by Journeyhorizon using Sharetribe Flex, DriveLah presented a complex and challenging build, pushing the boundaries of what was possible with the platform.
-[Remote Social](https://www.journeyh.io/portfolio/remote-social):Remote Social Experiences is a two-sided marketplace designed to connect organizations with providers of virtual and remote experiences, offering a range of activities tailored for team-building, employee engagement, and social interaction in a remote work environment.
- [Coral](https://www.journeyh.io/portfolio/coral):Coral is a premier two-sided marketplace tailored for accommodation bookings in the US, specifically designed to serve the film industry.
- [Rumblist](https://www.journeyh.io/portfolio/rumblist):Rumblist is a specialized two-sided marketplace dedicated to motorcycle parts and gear, designed to meet the unique needs of motorcycle enthusiasts.
- [Pasar Jasa](https://www.journeyh.io/portfolio/pasar-jasa):Pasar Jasa is a professional services platform for Indonesian SMEs. The platform was created to address the disconnect between SMEs and traditional firms, which are often not designed to serve small businesses effectively.
- [Handmade](https://www.journeyh.io/portfolio/hand-made):Handmade is a global two-sided marketplace similar to Etsy, designed to connect international sellers with buyers who appreciate handcrafted, unique products.

## Sharetribe Plugins
- [AI Product Description Generator](https://www.journeyh.io/services/sharetribe-plugins/ai-product-description-generator):AI Product Description Generator Plugin for Marketplace: Instantly create SEO-ready descriptions from images. Save costs, boost sales for e-commerce marketplaces & sellers using Sharetribe.
- [AI Search Box Plugin](https://www.journeyh.io/services/sharetribe-plugins/ai-search-box):Implement AI Search Box plugin into your marketplace with Journeyhorizon, the most trusted Sharetribe partner. Custom web & mobile solutions from build to scale.
- [Wishlist Plugin](https://www.journeyh.io/services/sharetribe-plugins#wishlist-plugin):Our advanced Wishlist feature is designed to enhance the shopping experience and drive engagement on your marketplace.
- [Single Vendor Shopping Cart Plugin](https://www.journeyh.io/services/sharetribe-plugins#single-vendor-shopping-cart-plugin):Our Single Vendor Shopping Cart feature is engineered to optimize the shopping experience and simplify transaction processes on your marketplace.
- [Bulk Upload](https://www.journeyh.io/services/sharetribe-plugins#bulk-upload-plugin):Our Bulk Upload feature is designed to streamline the process of adding multiple products to your marketplace, saving time and enhancing efficiency for your sellers.
- [Multi-user Accounts](https://www.journeyh.io/services/sharetribe-plugins#multi-user-accounts-plugin):Our Multi-User Accounts feature is designed to enhance collaboration and streamline operations on your marketplace by allowing both buyers and providers to delegate permissions and manage their accounts with team members.
- [Delete User Account](https://www.journeyh.io/services/sharetribe-plugins#delete-user-account-plugin):Our Delete User Account feature provides a secure and efficient way to manage user data, ensuring your marketplace remains compliant with data protection regulations.
- [Auto Menu based on category, sub-category, sub-sub-category](https://www.journeyh.io/services/sharetribe-plugins#auto-menu):Our Auto Menu feature dynamically generates menus based on categories, sub-categories, and sub-sub-categories, enhancing the user experience with intuitive and organized browsing.
- [Social Login](https://www.journeyh.io/services/sharetribe-plugins#social-login-plugin):Our Social Login feature enhances your marketplace's user experience with quick and easy login using social accounts: Google, X, LinkedIn and Apple ID.
- [Event Services](https://www.journeyh.io/services/sharetribe-plugins#event-services):Our Event Services is designed to help you automate integrations and tasks on your marketplace.
- [Biometric Login Plugin](https://www.journeyh.io/services/sharetribe-plugins#biometric-login-plugin):Our Biometric Login plugin is designed to revolutionize the way users access your marketplace, providing a secure and seamless authentication process without the need for passwords.
- [Shipping Plugin](https://www.journeyh.io/services/sharetribe-plugins#shipping-plugin):Our Shipping Plugin for the Sharetribe marketplace brings effortless, real-time shipping management right to your marketplace.
- [Rich Text Editor Plugin](https://www.journeyh.io/services/sharetribe-plugins#rich-text-editor-plugin):With easy-to-use formatting tools like headers, bold text, bullet points, and video embedding, you can highlight the key details that make your listings shine.
- [Realtime Messaging Plugin](https://www.journeyh.io/services/sharetribe-plugins#realtime-enquiries-messaging-plugin):With Realtime Messaging, marketplace users can communicate instantly, making transactions smoother and improving engagement.

> Journeyhorizon adalah pakar dalam pengembangan dan pemasaran pasar Sharetribe, membantu Anda membangun, meluncurkan, dan meningkatkan skala bisnis Anda.

Dengan keahlian di bidang Sharetribe dan Pemasaran, kami telah bekerja dengan perusahaan rintisan dan perusahaan di seluruh dunia, mengubah ide menjadi platform terdepan di pasar.

## Case Studies
- [Novabridge](https://www.journeyh.io/marketing-portfolio/novabridges-digital-transformation-powered-by-journeyhorizon):Novabridge, perusahaan konsultan terkemuka milik Australia dan Mitra Elit dalam ekosistem ServiceNow, meningkatkan kehadiran digital mereka dengan bantuan dari Journeyhorizon.
- [GearSource](https://www.journeyh.io/portfolio/gearsource):GearSource, didukung oleh platform Sharetribe dan dikembangkan oleh Journeyhorizon, adalah pasar global dua sisi yang dirancang untuk para profesional di industri audio, video, pencahayaan, dan pementasan.
- [Drivelah](https://www.journeyh.io/portfolio/drivelah):Sebagai salah satu proyek perintis yang dibangun oleh Journeyhorizon menggunakan Sharetribe Flex, DriveLah menghadirkan rancangan yang kompleks dan menantang, mendorong batasan dari apa yang mungkin dilakukan dengan platform tersebut.
-[Remote Social](https://www.journeyh.io/portfolio/remote-social):Remote Social Experiences adalah pasar dua sisi yang dirancang untuk menghubungkan organisasi dengan penyedia pengalaman virtual dan jarak jauh, menawarkan berbagai aktivitas yang dirancang untuk membangun tim, keterlibatan karyawan, dan interaksi sosial dalam lingkungan kerja jarak jauh.
- [Coral](https://www.journeyh.io/portfolio/coral):Coral adalah pasar dua sisi utama yang dirancang khusus untuk pemesanan akomodasi di AS, yang dirancang khusus untuk melayani industri film.
- [Rumblist](https://www.journeyh.io/portfolio/rumblist):Rumblist adalah pasar dua sisi khusus yang didedikasikan untuk suku cadang dan perlengkapan sepeda motor, yang dirancang untuk memenuhi kebutuhan unik para penggemar sepeda motor.
- [Pasar Jasa](https://www.journeyh.io/portfolio/pasar-jasa):Pasar Jasa adalah platform layanan profesional untuk UKM Indonesia. Platform ini diciptakan untuk mengatasi kesenjangan antara UKM dan perusahaan tradisional, yang seringkali tidak dirancang untuk melayani usaha kecil secara efektif.
- [Handmade](https://www.journeyh.io/portfolio/hand-made):Handmade adalah pasar global dua sisi yang mirip dengan Etsy, yang dirancang untuk menghubungkan penjual internasional dengan pembeli yang menghargai produk unik dan buatan tangan.

## Plugin Sharetribe
- [Generator Deskripsi Produk AI](https://www.journeyh.io/services/sharetribe-plugins/ai-product-description-generator):Plugin Generator Deskripsi Produk AI untuk Marketplace: Buat deskripsi yang siap SEO secara instan dari gambar. Hemat biaya, tingkatkan penjualan untuk marketplace & penjual e-commerce menggunakan Sharetribe.
- [Plugin Kotak Pencarian AI](https://www.journeyh.io/services/sharetribe-plugins/ai-search-box):Implementasikan plugin AI Search Box ke marketplace Anda bersama Journeyhorizon, mitra Sharetribe paling tepercaya. Solusi web & seluler khusus, mulai dari pengembangan hingga skalabilitas.
- [Plugin Daftar Keinginan](https://www.journeyh.io/services/sharetribe-plugins#wishlist-plugin):Fitur Daftar Keinginan kami yang canggih dirancang untuk meningkatkan pengalaman berbelanja dan mendorong keterlibatan di pasar Anda.
- [Plugin Keranjang Belanja Vendor Tunggal](https://www.journeyh.io/services/sharetribe-plugins#single-vendor-shopping-cart-plugin):Fitur Keranjang Belanja Vendor Tunggal kami dirancang untuk mengoptimalkan pengalaman berbelanja dan menyederhanakan proses transaksi di pasar Anda.
- [Unggah Massal](https://www.journeyh.io/services/sharetribe-plugins#bulk-upload-plugin):Fitur Unggah Massal kami dirancang untuk menyederhanakan proses penambahan banyak produk ke pasar Anda, menghemat waktu dan meningkatkan efisiensi bagi penjual Anda.
- [Akun Multi-Pengguna](https://www.journeyh.io/services/sharetribe-plugins#multi-user-accounts-plugin):Fitur Akun Multi-Pengguna kami dirancang untuk meningkatkan kolaborasi dan menyederhanakan operasi di pasar Anda dengan memungkinkan pembeli dan penyedia mendelegasikan izin dan mengelola akun mereka dengan anggota tim.
- [Hapus Akun Pengguna](https://www.journeyh.io/services/sharetribe-plugins#delete-user-account-plugin):Fitur Hapus Akun Pengguna kami menyediakan cara yang aman dan efisien untuk mengelola data pengguna, memastikan pasar Anda tetap mematuhi peraturan perlindungan data.
- [Menu Otomatis berdasarkan kategori, subkategori, sub-sub-kategori](https://www.journeyh.io/services/sharetribe-plugins#auto-menu):Fitur Menu Otomatis kami secara dinamis menghasilkan menu berdasarkan kategori, subkategori, dan sub-subkategori, meningkatkan pengalaman pengguna dengan penelusuran yang intuitif dan terorganisir.
- [Login Sosial](https://www.journeyh.io/services/sharetribe-plugins#social-login-plugin):Fitur Login Sosial kami meningkatkan pengalaman pengguna pasar Anda dengan login cepat dan mudah menggunakan akun sosial: Google, X, LinkedIn, dan Apple ID.
- [Layanan Acara](https://www.journeyh.io/services/sharetribe-plugins#event-services):Layanan Acara kami dirancang untuk membantu Anda mengotomatiskan integrasi dan tugas di pasar Anda.
- [Plugin Login Biometrik](https://www.journeyh.io/services/sharetribe-plugins#biometric-login-plugin):Plugin Login Biometrik kami dirancang untuk merevolusi cara pengguna mengakses pasar Anda, menyediakan proses autentikasi yang aman dan lancar tanpa memerlukan kata sandi.
- [Plugin Pengiriman](https://www.journeyh.io/services/sharetribe-plugins#shipping-plugin):Plugin Pengiriman kami untuk pasar Sharetribe menghadirkan pengelolaan pengiriman yang mudah dan real-time langsung ke pasar Anda.
- [Plugin Editor Teks Kaya](https://www.journeyh.io/services/sharetribe-plugins#rich-text-editor-plugin):Dengan alat pemformatan yang mudah digunakan seperti tajuk, teks tebal, poin-poin penting, dan penyematan video, Anda dapat menyorot detail utama yang membuat iklan Anda menonjol.
- [Plugin Pesan Waktu Nyata](https://www.journeyh.io/services/sharetribe-plugins#realtime-enquiries-messaging-plugin):Dengan Realtime Messaging, pengguna marketplace dapat berkomunikasi secara instan, membuat transaksi lebih lancar dan meningkatkan keterlibatan.
